newsitem.title: EGYPT: Mufti says Arabs might have to fight for Jerusalem.
newsitem.headline: Mufti says Arabs might have to fight for Jerusalem.

text.p: The Mufti of Jerusalem said in remarks published on Sunday he doubted the Palestinians could regain control of the city through negotiations and the only alternative would be war.

Akrama Sabri, the chief Islamic authority in Jerusalem, told the international newspapaer al-Hayat that Israeli-Palestinian negotiations were unsatisfactory because Israel refused to acknowledge Palestinian rights.

"I believe that recovering Jerusalem through the negotiations is something impossible. If the Palestinian leadership is unable to win the city back through negotiations, we will have no option but war," he added.
The dispute over Jerusalem has developed into a crisis since Israel decided last week to build new houses for Jews in the Arab east sector of the city, captured in 1967.
